tokenops.name: fetchUsageByAgent
tokenops.description: The CALLER'S OWN usage, grouped by agent — not the fleet's. The SQL filters on the session user (oss/server/src/usage/routes.rs:256) and looks back a fixed 30 days (routes.rs:243, default_days at routes.rs:32; the frontend never sends `days`, so no range filter reaches it). tokenops.answersMeans: a value per CATEGORY, one row per thing — a bar, donut or ranking

tokenops.answersMeans: summary (a KPI strip, no chart) + series (a line chart) + breakdown (a bar, donut or ranking) in one response

tokenops.name: fetchSpendCalendar
tokenops.description: One calendar MONTH of daily spend, one row per day with an operations count and a 0-1 `intensity` already computed against that month's maximum - a heatmap shade without a second pass. `month` is required and is "YYYY-MM" in UTC, not a range: 24h/7d/30d go to fetchSpendTimeseries instead. `highlighted_dates` marks which days fall inside the caller's active range. Real backend: GET /api/observability/finops/spend-calendar.

argsShape.month: "YYYY-MM", REQUIRED - a calendar month in UTC, not a range
argsShape.range: "24h" | "7d" | "30d", optional - only selects which days come back flagged in highlighted_dates; it does NOT narrow `days`

tokenops.answersMeans: a value over TIME, one point per bucket — a line chart

days.intensity: number (0.0-1.0, relative to the month's max)

tokenops.name: fetchFinopsAttributions
tokenops.description: Fleet-wide per-agent or per-workflow cost rows, sorted and paged by the SERVER - the same rows as fetchTokenopsDashboard's data.attributions.rows, but re-sortable without re-running the KPI and timeseries work behind the dashboard. Use this when the surface is a table the user will sort or page; use the dashboard when the table sits beside KPIs and is read once. `view` picks the row shape and is echoed back at data.view. There is NO total or row count in the response, so `limit`/`offset` cannot drive a "page N of M" control - offer next/previous or a plain top-N, not a pager. Real backend: GET /api/observability/finops/attributions.

argsShape.range: "24h" | "7d" | "30d" - wins over startTime/endTime when both are sent
argsShape.view: "agent" | "workflow" - decides which row shape comes back, default "agent"
argsShape.offset: number, optional - no total is returned, so this cannot number the pages

tokenops.answersMeans: a value per CATEGORY, one row per thing — a bar, donut or ranking
